fields.statement: At d9367578, go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -count=1 -run TestScripts/(owner-run-gate-accept|run-gate|autonomous-gate-rule|stage-autonomy|plan-workflow-autonomous|autonomous-review) passes. In the new owner-run-gate-accept.txtar, a non-autonomous hold run's gate with accept auto and a clean review round accepts both proposed change sets under rule autonomy, and the run journal has 2 accepted entries; a second gate adds none. With accept owner, and with accept auto but a confirmed finding no question was left for, the gate exits 0, leaves the change set proposed with next rhiza accept --rule owner --change <id>, and journals no accepted entry. The autonomous gate scripts are unchanged and still pass. In the diff, runRunGate keeps the autonomous path (failure when the review has not passed, open questions stopping the run, rule autonomous); an owner run uses rule autonomy, which checkAutonomousRule allows only while RHIZA_RUN names an unfinished run; the rhiza.autonomy.accept setting's comment now says it governs every plan run's gate. go test -trimpath -timeout 30m -skip 'TestReadBudget|TestWriteBudget' ./internal/api/... passes. The full package run failed only TestReadBudget, a wall-clock read budget, on a machine with load average 6-9 from parallel runs. This diff changes no read path, so that failure is load, not this change; CI's make check covers the budget.
